wish: someone should make an app that makes seamless pixel tiles
spec:
A pixel editor whose canvas wraps at the edges, with a live 3x3 tiled preview so seams show while you draw.
Pick a size and color, draw, erase or fill (fills continue across edges), use offset 1/2 or shift to check seams, then export a PNG at 1-16x.
It does not animate, use layers, or upload anything; the tile is kept only in this browser.
